form.title: Credit for Prior Year Minimum Tax—Individuals, Estates, and Trusts
form.notes: refundable: false. Line 25 goes to Schedule 3 Part I line 6b. In force for 2025, unchanged by P.L. 119-21. It refunds prior-year alternative minimum tax paid on DEFERRAL items only — it is not a credit for any expenditure made this year, and Part I exists purely to strip out the exclusion items that never generate a credit. The refundable version of this credit that existed for 2007 through 2012 under section 53(e) is long gone; this is wholly nonrefundable. Unused amounts carry forward indefinitely at line 26. Printed revision: Form 8801 (2025), Created 11/12/25.
